description: PHP class implementing a cookie jar that persists session cookies in the client's session storage, extending the base CookieJar class to add session persistence functionality.

classes.name: SessionCookieJar
classes.description: A cookie jar that saves and loads cookies to and from the client session, specifically designed to persist session cookies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the jar with a session key and optional session cookies persistence flag, then loads existing cookies from session.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that saves current cookies into the session upon object destruction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies into JSON and saves them into PHP session storage under the specified key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from PHP session storage, reconstructs them, and populates the cookie jar; throws exception if data is invalid.
